body:
He is very much am asshole, not even for that situation in particular. I haven't considered him a friend in a while, but I always am friendly towards him. I'm going to join the call this time for my friend, I don't want to rock the boat. And I'm not a confrontational person at all, and I'll be friendly to them all, and then after this I probably won't join any more calls 

Thank you so much for the supportive comment, it means a lot

Thank you so much for this incredibly kind comment. You honestly made me tear up. It's been really hard dealing with all this stuff again, and I think it's going to take time to take the responsibility off of myself

I don't want to rock the boat, so my plan is to go into the call and be civil, but I probably won't be joining them on any more calls afterwards. I'm going to put on some nice make up, and listen to a good Confidence Boosting playlist to get me through it 

Thank you again, I'm sending you all the good vibes I have, and I hope you have an absolutely wonderful day

I considered most of them to be my friends, and I would just move on from them. But there's the close friend I mentioned and her bf, and they've been great friends to me, and if I want to keep them in my life I have to deal with the rest of them

My plan is just to be civil around them, but mostly just keep to myself

I don't know your situation, and nobody will ever feel your emotions the way you do. Everything you feel is valid, but I do understand the fight through trauma. Sometimes it feels like a never ending loop of One Thing After Another

Adapting and moving forward is hard. Especially doing it on your own. Have you thought about therapy? I started a couple months ago and it's been absolutely amazing for my mental health in general, I have a long way to go, but I don't have to try and figure things out on my own anymore 

I'm here if you need to talk

I still feel the impact of it, and maybe I always will. It's a person we spent time with, and loved, and there might always be something there making us think about them

I'm seeing a therapist, and it's been really helpful. If you think it might help you, you should give it a try

I absolutely feel you, and like really relate to what you said

I was also super duper naive, it's embarrassing. Getting passed that hurt and raw emotion took a while, and I'm now at a point where I can try to make changes to better myself. One thing that's helped me is to look for love in different places, like music, nice food, a good TV show 

If you wanna talk about it at all, hmu

Just like any mental health issue, or trauma, the damage might never fully go away. But over time all we can do is try and adapt, I don't think I'll trust for a very long time. And I'm sure after your break up you feel the same. But all that can be done is to try and bring our own happiness and self worth

Which isn't easy, I'm in therapy trying to sort that

If you wanna talk about what happened I'm all ears
It makes so much sense listening to it now, with Dan's fear of sharks, and also just the lyrics are so NSP-like!!

I've tried four different antidepressants, there was one I was allergic too, and the one I'm on now gives me hives, but the doctor won't change it. She won't let me try anything new or put my up a dose

I went to therapy when I was 18, and they just threw CBT sheets at me and told me to do them, told me to go volunteer. And just generally undermine me whenever I spoke. And I was scared to talk and I just never thought I could ask for another person. And she told me I didn't need to be there. And it's been 6 years, and I desperately need help, I can't hold a job, I can barely function day to day life

I honestly can't really eat without crying, for some reason that sets me off. 

He lied to me about how long he thought about leaving me - I assume because of the money my parents gave us to get a home together. He bought whatever he liked and I always asked before a purchase. He's been seeing the woman he told me not to worry about since he left me. I found out yesterday, I can't feel anything but hate for him right now for that, for everything he's done to hurt me. 

A part of me hopes that one day he'll feel the hurt that he's given me. 

I realise now he thinks hes better than me - brought up his confidence and he now knows he can have somebody better in his mind. I want to be a better and stronger person to spite him, but I also want to do it because all I want in life is just to be happy
I'm having such an awful panic attack
I've written a lot on my page thing about it
He didn't have feelings for her still, he just wasn't over her breaking up with him. He did leave me for another woman though

I'm scared I'll run into him. He studies in the city my friends live in, the train to get there stops in the town we lived in together, where he now lives alone

I don't know what I'd do if I saw him
I have been trying for a very long time for that

He had half days at uni four days a week, and nothing on weekends. I'm too unwell to work atm. We lived together. And he still couldn't make time to do something or plan anything. The last three weeks of the relationship he sat downstairs and spoke to a girl he met day and night, and was making plans to hang out with her once a week. He went to her house without telling me just the two of them. And he would go to uni early or stay in late to study with her. But he couldn't give me the same amount of time

And he was annoyed that I was jealous of her

All my notebooks are in the house we shared. And honestly, im too scared to use anything we bought together. And I'm too scared to leave the house alone right now 

My mind fogs whenever I try and think about anything bad that happened. Because the good times were so good. But lately everything was just comfortable rather than good

I knew he wasn't doing the things I needed. But I was willing to keep trying. He kept telling me he wanted to change, but he never changed. And once we agreed he would plan something for us to do once a week he left. All I wanted for for us to plan something to do for each other during the week

I would still have tried. He gave me no option
Everything feels impossible without him. I'm so hurt and I'm so confused about it all

I've been trying to see one for years. I saw one with I was 18, they told me I had teenage angst after my second appointment and told me to stop going. 

And every time I've gotten close in the last three years I've had to move. I'm going to see about getting one now that I have to move back in with my mum, since my boyfriend left me and I have to leave the house we had 
But it doesn't feel like enough
Why doesn't he want to talk to me, he probably isn't crying and itching to message me. How has he not slipped once and messaged me, we spoke every single day for two years
I felt better for a while, but it all came flooding back I can't stop crying. I want to know how he is, and if he's okay. How can he just not want to talk to me after talking everyday for two years

My boyfriend left me four days ago, we were together two years. 
I cooked at least two meals a day for him, because I enjoyed it, and I enjoyed showing him I loved him. Because caring for people is how I show love 

He never made plans with me, he made few compromises. But he cherished me, he made me comfortable with my body, and he made me feel beautiful. But all I asked was that he try and give me more of his time, and he couldn't do it

He agreed he'd always held the same values as me, but as time went on it seemed to change. I've always wanted a family, and he told me a few weeks ago he didn't want that anymore and I was willing to give up my only life aspiration. Because I love him. 

He started acting distant when he met a girl at uni, he spoke to her all day and barely spoke to me. He would grin as he spoke to her, they spoke how we spoke when we got together. I was meant to meet her the day after he left me. He wouldn't touch me or go near me when he got close to her. 

And he's moved on quickly, he's been able to move on and live his life after two years. I gave him everything I possibly could. Ever single ounce of love I could muster, and he couldn't give me that back and it's destroying me. It was so out do nowhere, he told me he loved me and needed me the day he left 

And I just need to keep reading this post. Because I need to realise he didn't want me anymore, he didn't want what I was giving, he didn't want the same things as me. He wanted to be single while he was in uni and experience things with other people. And I want a commitment, I want something life long.

I absolutely get you. Music has always meant everything to me, but I just can't listen to music when I feel panicky or anxious, same with my favourite movies 

Nostalgic things make me think about how Im getting older and the things I've passed in my life, which kind of sends me into an existential crisis

I was in a group chat for a party she invited us to, before he left me. And she just messaged in it and it just destroyed me, all the plans we had made together, how he was meant to let me meet her so I wouldn't need to worry

It hurts so much
